title: Trend quality familywise selection adjustment
extraction_rule: Select recorded familywise max-t and raw bootstrap p for V1–V5, no new inference. Familywise pass threshold 0.05.

study_context.universe: liquid cash after minimum history, positive OHLC and prior traded-value filters
study_context.instrument: unlevered integer-share delivery equities; cash retained when underinvested
study_context.benchmark: unfiltered S0, binding unfiltered EMA20/50 comparator; NIFTYBEES buy-and-hold reference
study_context.costs: recorded delivery-equity statutory costs, DP charge and base 5 bps slippage per side
study_context.execution: weekly after-close decision; exact next-session open; quality strictly through t-1; fold training-only quality boundaries
study_context.inference: direct quality date/symbol two-way clustered regression with controls; moving-block familywise max-t versus S0
study_context.source_verdict: kill-quality-family; HQ falsified; HR falsified; priority-selected variant none

caveats: Post-hoc historical development; no live/shadow authorization.
V0 already-observed reference and EMA quality-filter diagnostic are not selectable variants or binding controls.
Only wf1–wf4 count as complete folds; wf5_partial is excluded from the fold gate.
Full-capital NIFTYBEES CAGR has materially greater exposure and volatility; compare risks before interpreting returns.
Daily NAV was not persisted; no equity, underwater or rolling-Sharpe curves can be reconstructed from summary metrics.
Archived TSS diagnosis seal points to an engine whose bytes later changed; current-code parity is not promised.
Moving blocks and HAC lag are each 63 sessions; 10,000 archived resamples.
display_rounding: At most four decimals; integer counts unchanged
missing_values: null stays unavailable; never plotted as zero
transformation: One bar per recorded numeric value; no interpolation, resampling, inference or optimization
